description: Source code for MemBackendImpl class managing in-memory disk cache, including cache initialization, entry management, eviction policies, and memory pressure handling.

classes.name: MemBackendImpl
classes.description: Implementation of in-memory cache backend with eviction and memory pressure handling.

classes.name: MemBackendImpl::MemIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing cache entries.

methods.name: CreateBackend
methods.description: Factory method to create and initialize a MemBackendImpl instance with specified max size.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes cache size based on system memory if not already set.

methods.name: SetMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum cache size.

methods.name: MaxFileSize
methods.description: Returns maximum size for individual cache files.

methods.name: OnEntryInserted
methods.description: Handles cache entry insertion into LRU list.

methods.name: OnEntryUpdated
methods.description: Updates cache entry position in LRU list upon modification.

methods.name: OnEntryDoomed
methods.description: Removes cache entry from tracking structures upon dooming.

methods.name: ModifyStorageSize
methods.description: Adjusts current cache size and triggers eviction if needed.

methods.name: HasExceededStorageSize
methods.description: Checks if cache size exceeds maximum limit.

methods.name: SetPostCleanupCallback
methods.description: Sets callback to run after cleanup.

methods.name: Now
methods.description: Returns current time, optionally using a custom clock for testing.

methods.name: SetClockForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom clock for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns number of cache entries.

methods.name: OpenOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Opens existing or creates new cache entry for a key.

methods.name: OpenEntry
methods.description: Opens an existing cache entry.

methods.name: CreateEntry
methods.description: Creates a new cache entry.

methods.name: DoomEntry
methods.description: Dooms (deletes) a cache entry by key.

methods.name: DoomAllEntries
methods.description: Dooms all cache entries.

methods.name: DoomEntriesBetween
methods.description: Dooms cache entries last used within a time range.

methods.name: DoomEntriesSince
methods.description: Dooms cache entries last used since a specific time.

methods.name: CalculateSizeOfAllEntries
methods.description: Returns total size of all cache entries.

methods.name: CalculateSizeOfEntriesBetween
methods.description: Calculates total size of entries within a time range.

methods.name: CreateIterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator for cache entries.

methods.name: OnExternalCacheHit
methods.description: Updates entry state on cache hit.

methods.name: EvictIfNeeded
methods.description: Evicts entries if cache exceeds max size.

methods.name: EvictTill
methods.description: Evicts entries until target size is reached.

methods.name: OnMemoryPressure
methods.description: Handles system memory pressure by evicting cache entries.
